chapter_title: Concerning the Twelve Signs of the Zodiac and the
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


---


**
¶2**


Whether
 those
 twelve fixed
 genera
 of falsity that
 are established
 in
 the external
 natural
 mind, or those five active ruling ev
ils that move
 through them
 —
 all
 of these
 are dom
inating principles according
 to their very
 nature
. They are mut
ually opposed,
 each fals
ity war
ring against every
 other,
 each
 evil
 underm
ining the rest
,
 threatening
 and
 consuming
 one
 another. This
 is so
 by
 the operation
 of Divine
 Providence, which has
 formed
 the
 whole arrangement
 of the spiritual
 world
.
 Providence
 has
 gathered
 these
 hostile
 ev
ils together and bound them within
 the revol
ving order
 of the natural mind,
 which
 turns
 ce
aselessly through
 its
 states. And
 while it turns and over
turns them, they en
act whatever
 their nature
 comp
els,
 in
 the interior
 and the
 exterior mind
,
 according to their inher
ent desire
. Nevertheless
, the
 Lord
's Providence stands
 as
 guardian
 over them and
 as
 an
 ex
actor above
 them —
 compelling, constra
ining, and rec
laiming from
 them whatever of
 good and
 truth they
 have
 seized
.

---


**¶3**

This
 is how it may
 rightly be understood. These
 twelve
 genera
 of ruling
 falsity were seized
 out
 of the five origins
 of evil and
 bound within
 the order
 of the natural mind. Two genera
 of
 falsity were taken from
 each origin
. The
 paired
 fals
ities of
 double
-
mind
edness and
 self
-just
ifying
 reasoning
 belong
 to the origin
 of obsc
ured understanding —
 that
 is, the
 dark
ened intell
ect. In contrast, the falsities
 of infl
amed
 pride
 and dom
ine
ering will
 belong to the origin of self-love
.
 The
 falsities of compl
iant de
ception
,
 counter
feited
 equity
, and hollow
 balance
 belong to the origin of vain reasoning
 from
 the
 prop
rium. The
 falsities of fluct
uating sentiment
, out
ward p
urity
 conce
aling inward corruption, and imm
ersion
 in sens
uous
 appearances
 belong to the origin of falsity flowing
 through the understanding. The
 falsities of rigid
 world
liness and
 conce
aled
 mal
ice belong to the origin of profound spiritual
 ignorance.
 These are the twelve ruling
 principles
 of depravity, and
 wick
edness shall never
 be
 free
 of
 them.
 For they cause every
 evil in
 the world —
 whether in perception
 or in the will
.


---

**¶4**


Understand also concerning
 the
 five active
 ruling
 evils,
 the leading
 loves
: from
 what
 origin
 was
 each generated
? The
 ruling
 love
 corresponding
 to Jupiter
 was
 generated from obsc
ured understanding — that is, from
 the darkened intellect assuming
 the
 appearance
 of ben
evolence. In contrast, the ruling
 love corresponding to Venus arose
 from self-love — conc
upiscence cloth
ed in de
light
. The ruling love corresponding to Mars belongs
 to vain reasoning — agg
ression born
 of inflated thought. The ruling love
 corresponding to Mercury belongs to falsity flowing
 through the understanding — cun
ning that
 
imitates intelligence
. The ruling love corresponding to Saturn belongs
 to profound spiritual
 darkness
 — the cold
 obst
in
acy of 
utter
 ignorance.

---

**
¶5**

Furthermore
, the two generating
 principles of all
 these
 evils are r
eckoned as
 belonging
 to self
-
love and conc
upiscence — the
 active
 and
 the recept
ive,
 the willing
 and the cr
aving. These are the father-
principle
 and the mother-principle from
 which every
 particular evil and
 falsity is begotten.

---


**¶6**

And
 also, Divine
 Good and Divine Truth —
 which
 in
 the natural mind appear
 to
 be counted
 among the ruling powers
 as
 though
 belonging
 to their
 kind — why
 are
 they r
eckoned among them? So that they
 may
 reign
 over them. For
 upon
 examination
, it
 is discovered that Providence
 through
 Divine
 Good
 and Divine Truth subj
ugates every
 evil and
 falsity at every moment.


---

**¶7**


These seven that
 have
 been named — the five active ruling
 evils together
 with the two generating principles of concup
iscence — these
 are the agents
 of all
 wick
edness that
 accomplish
 every evil and destruct
ive work
 throughout
 every
 region
 of the mind
, its
 whole
 extent, interior
 and exterior,
 in every created
 aff
ection, in the active
 and the
 receptive, in every living
 form
, in perception
 and in the will
.

---

**¶8
**

Once more it
 is revealed concerning
 these genera
 of ruling
 falsity: they
 are distributed and
 appointed according
 to four quarters
, three to
 each quarter
 in
 these four fundamental
 regions
 of
 the mind. And they are fixed to
 the revolving order
 of
 natural
 states.
 The
 fals
ities of infl
amed pride,
 domineering will, and
 self
-just
ifying reasoning —
 these three belong to one
 quarter. In contrast, the falsities
 of compliant deception, rigid
 worldliness, and out
ward purity conce
aling inward corruption — these three belong
 to another quarter. Then
 the
 falsities of double
-mindedness, counterfeited equity
, and hollow balance belong
 to yet
 another quarter. And
 conce
aled malice, imm
ersion in sensuous appearances, and fluct
uating sentiment belong
 to the remaining
 quarter. They
 are placed in this
 manner
, appointed to these four regions
 of
 the mind, and distributed throughout
 the revolving order
.

---

**¶9
**

So when the quarter of infl
amed pride, domineering will,
 and self-justifying reasoning is pl
undered by
 the
 Providence
 that stands over it —
 which
 ex
acts re
stitution from it,
 together
 with the active
 ev
ils that
 move through it — at that instant,
 affliction strikes all the natural
 affections below
,
 for
 the
 animal
 nature
 of
 the will
 is
 sh
aken. However, when the quarter of
 compliant deception, out
ward purity,
 and rigid
 worldliness is plundered,
 then
 affl
iction falls
 upon every
 growing
 perception
, together
 with the kn
owledges of
 good
,
 and all
 the works that
 arise
 from understanding
 —
 for the veget
ative
 life
 of
 the mind
 is laid
 bare
. Yet again, when the quarter of
 conce
aled malice, immersion in sens
uous appearances, and fluctuating sentiment
 is plundered, then
 scarcity bef
alls whatever
 tru
ths remain
 accessible
 in the natural mind, and spiritual
 drought spre
ads from region
 to region. Conversely, when
 the quarter of double-mindedness,
 counterfeited equity, and hollow balance
 is plundered, then deform
ity and dist
ortion befall the very
 rational
 human
 form itself,
 from
 region to region —
 for it
 is the understanding
 proper
 to
 humanity
 that is ass
aulted.

---

**
¶10**

Behold,
 it
 has now
 been shown
 concerning
 these twelve genera of ruling falsity:
 they
 were fashioned from
 the five origins of evil and bound within
 the revolving order of the natural mind
.

---

**¶11
**

It has also been taught concerning
 the other five,
 the active
 ruling
 evils: they
 too arose
 from the five origins in
 the realm
 of spiritual
 darkness.

---

**¶
12**

It has been recounted
 also
 concerning the two generating
 principles:
 they are set according
 to the mystery of self
-love and concupiscence.
 They are the active
 and the receptive, the father
-
principle and the mother-principle of
 all evil.

---

**
¶13**

And
 it
 has been revealed concerning Divine
 Good and Divine Truth: they are stran
gers to all
 these
 evils and
 falsities. Yet
 because of the constraint
 of provid
ential order
 —
 in that every
 created
 thing receives its
 life
 and
 light
 from them
,
 and because Providence
 operates
 through them
 to
 rec
laim and
 pl
under whatever the
 ev
ils have seized — for
 this reason they were counted among the
 ruling powers in
 the
 r
eckoning of appearances
. For Divine
 Good and Divine Truth proceed
 from the Divine
 itself;
 they do not belong to the active
 ev
ils or
 to
 the fixed
 genera
 of falsity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Whether these twelve signs of the zodiac that are fixed on the sphere, or these five stars that circle upon them; those and these are rulers, all of them, according to their essence. They are all enemies and rivals to each other ⟨one oppresses another, they threaten each other⟩. They plunder one another by the action of the great craftsman who has formed all the worlds. He has gathered [them] and bound them on the sphere above, which circles constantly. Now, while it circles and tumbles them, so they shall do everything that they desire, above and below, according to their pleasure. Nevertheless, a guardian is over them, a debt-collector above them; compelling, extorting, and taking what is theirs away from them!

Now, this is how it can rightly be understood. They were [s]eized from the five worlds of darkness, and bound on the sphere. Two zodiacal signs were taken per world. Gemini and Sagittarius belong to the world of smoke, which is the mind. In contrast, Aries and Leo belong to the world of fire. Taurus, Aquarius and Libra belong to the world of wind. Cancer and Virgo and [P]isces belong to the world of water. Capricorn and Scorpio belong to the world of darkness. These are the twelve rulers of depravity, the ones that wicked[ness] shall not [depart from.] For they cause all the evil and [every affliction in the wo]rld, whether in tree or in flesh.

And understand also about these five stars, the leaders: from where were they formed? The star of Zeus (Jupiter) was generated from the world of smoke, which is the mind. In contrast, Aphrodite (Venus) came about from the world of fire. And then Ares (Mars) belongs to the world of wind. Hermes (Mercury) belongs to the world of water. Cronos (Saturn) belongs to the world [of] darkness.
And also, the two ascendants are counted to fire and desire, the dry and the moist. They are the father and the mother of all these.
And also, the sun and the moon, which are counted in with them as a rule so that they would reign over them. You will discover they subjugate them at every moment.

These seven we have named, the five stars and the two ascendants: They are the doers of wickedness that do every wicked and bad act in every land, the whole of it, above and below, in every creature, in the dry and the moist, in tree and flesh.

[They] are distributed, appointed on four sides, three per angle in these four places. And they are fixed to this revolving sphere. Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, they three belong to a single side. In contrast, Taurus, Capricorn and Virgo, these other three belong to another side. And then, Gemini, Libra and Aquarius belong to another side. Scorpio, Pisces and Cancer belong to another corner. Now, they are placed like this, appointed to these four parts, and distributed on the sphere.

So, when the side of Aries, Leo and Sagittarius will be plundered by the guardian who is over it, who extorts from it and the leaders who move upon it; at that instant shall affliction strike all the four-footed creatures below. However, when [the side] of Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn will be plundered; [affliction] shall at once befall the herbs, together with the vegetables and all the fruits of the trees. Yet again, when the side of Scorpio, Pisces and Cancer will be plundered; scarcity shall befall the waters upon the earth, and drought be from place to place. Conversely, should the side of Gemini, Libra and Aquarius be plundered; deformity and stuntedness shall befall the form of mankind from place to place.
They were fashioned from the five worlds of darkness, and bound on the sphere.
They too came about from the five worlds of the land of darkness.
They are set to the mystery of fire and desire. They are the dry and the moist, the father and the mother.

They are strangers to them. Still, because of the constraint of the arrangement, in that the thing receives light, and as they belong and plunder them; because of this they were counted in with them in relation to the calculation of the number. For, the sun and the moon are from out of the greatness, not belonging to the stars and the signs of the zodiac.
